note: The term limit, said once at 2.6.3 (section 6). Its last sentence, on the party's 2027 nomination list, stays.

note: The term limit, said once at 2.6.3; his 2022 total is 2.2's.
text: *   **Julius Malombe (Incumbent Governor, Kitui County):** Won the 2022 general election with {{result.2022.gov.malombe}} votes (Tier 1, IEBC Form 37C) after serving a first term from 2013–2017. He is not in the 2027 field: Article 180(7) of the Constitution limits a governor to two terms, and he has served two. The race is for an open seat (Section 2.6.3), and his record is the one every candidate in it will be measured against.
